final: WITH p AS (SELECT e.ID, pt.SEX AS SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS g, AVG(e.ANA) AS a FROM Examination e JOIN Patient pt ON pt.ID = e.ID GROUP BY e.ID, pt.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(g) AS avg_igg, AVG(a) AS avg_ana FROM p GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM s) AS ana_ratio FROM s
